title: Monthly Raku Firing
summary: Norris Arts fires raku monthly on the third Monday of each month. The studio welcomes participants and observers.
how_to_join: Contact the studio at 360.824.5449 or info@norrisarts.com.
source_quote: If it's the 3rd Mon of the month, it must be raku day at Casa de Norris. And we had a brief and spectacular firing session
evidence_sentence: The Instagram post states raku firings happen on the third Monday each month, with participants invited.
